guard: every census item needs a well-formed owner row and every row a live item; the extractor reads endpoint input fields at nested depth, so a field added under an existing command fails until mapped; an owner naming an unregistered command or undeclared flag fails
why: Each mutation removes one check the census relies on and must redden the cell that names it.

mutations.name: an item with no owner row is no longer reported
mutations.find: if (owner === undefined) problems.push(`${id}: no owner row`);
mutations.expectRed: a field added under an existing command fails as unowned
mutations.cell: a field added under an existing command fails as unowned

mutations.name: a current owner is accepted without its command being registered
mutations.find: if (!flags) return `${item}: owner names "${parsed.command}", which is not a registered command`;
mutations.expectRed: an owner naming no registered command fails
mutations.cell: an owner naming no registered command fails

mutations.name: nested input fields are no longer extracted
mutations.expectRed: endpoint items reach nested input fields and target modes
mutations.cell: endpoint items reach nested input fields and target modes
